Open Door Band

Open Door Band · A beginner-friendly concert band in The Villages, Florida · Rehearsals at Olympia Recreation Center

📍 The Villages, Florida | ✉️ hello@OpenDoorBand.org | 📘 Facebook

Open Door Band is an independent Resident Lifestyle Group within The Villages community and is not affiliated with or sponsored by Bands of The Villages (BOTV) or any of its member organizations.

Participation is open to residents of The Villages and their eligible guests with valid Guest IDs.
